name: MeetingCard
description: A meeting card shows one event in an agenda or schedule: its name, time and attendees, with a color edge for its status. It is built from Avatar and AvatarGroup.
whenToUse: In agendas, schedules and sidebars listing upcoming meetings or events.
For short status items with people attached, e.g. who is on call for a service.

whenNotToUse.text: For a message that needs action.

anatomy.name: Accent edge
anatomy.description: Status color on the inline start (left in LTR, right in RTL).

anatomy.name: Time
anatomy.description: When it happens; a <time> element when dateTime is set.

values.meaning: Needs attention, e.g. starts soon or has a conflict risk.

states.name: Default
states.meaning: Meeting cards are static; put links or buttons inside for actions.

behavior.text: Up to maxAttendees (default 4) avatars show, then “+N”. Screen readers hear the group label and each name.
Pass dateTime (ISO) to render a <time> element that software can read.
The accent edge moves to the right side.

content: Title: the meeting’s name, not its type (“Q3 planning”, not “Meeting”).
Time: the range in the reader’s time format; add the day if it isn’t today.
If the variant matters, say it in words too, e.g. “Cancelled”.

guidelines.do: Say the status in the title or time, e.g. “Cancelled: Budget review”.
guidelines.dont: Rely on the red edge alone to mean cancelled.
guidelines.why: Color alone isn’t seen by everyone (WCAG 1.4.1).

guidelines.do: Give every attendee a real name.
guidelines.why: Names become initials when photos fail and are what screen readers announce.

guidelines.do: Pick the heading level that fits the page (titleAs).
guidelines.dont: Leave h3 under an h1 with no h2.
guidelines.why: A logical outline helps people navigate by headings.

keyboard.action: Not focusable itself; any links or buttons inside are.

wcag.how: Heading, <time> and a labelled attendee group.
Status must also be written; the guidelines require it.
Title and time pass 4.5:1 on every variant background in every theme.

examples.title: Meeting
Cancelled
examples.description: The danger variant, with the status in words.
examples.code:
import { MeetingCard } from '@ds/react';

<MeetingCard variant="danger" title="Cancelled: Budget review" time="16:00 – 17:30" />

examples.title: Agenda list
examples.description: A list of meetings under a heading.

changes: attendees ({ name, src }) replaces avatars (URLs), rendered with AvatarGroup.
New warning variant; accent edge uses logical properties (flips in RTL).
Tokens renamed to the grammar: -title-color → -title-text-color, -time-color → -time-text-color; the direction border helpers were removed.

components.name: MeetingCard
components.description: A meeting or event in an agenda: title, time and attendees, color-coded by status.

time.description: When it happens, formatted for display, e.g. "10:00 – 11:00".

variant.description:
Color of the card. Pick by meaning and say it in the title or time as well:
`primary` (default) a regular meeting, `success` confirmed or done, `warning` needs
attention, e.g. it's about to start, `danger` cancelled or clashing.

attendees.description: People attending, shown as overlapping avatars.

maxAttendees.description: Show at most this many avatars, then a "+N" count. Default 4.

attendeesLabel.description: Name of the avatar group for screen readers. Default "Attendees".

titleAs.description: Heading level that fits the page outline. Default h3.
